test_cases.name: Verify OBS SDK import
test_cases.command: python3 -c "from obs import ObsClient; print('OBS SDK available')"

test_cases.name: Generate basic signed URL (GET)
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_signed_url.py --bucket-name test-bucket --object-key test.txt --method GET --expires 3600 --server obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com

test_cases.name: Generate signed URL with image resize
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_signed_url.py --bucket-name test-bucket --object-key photo.jpg --method GET --expires 3600 --server obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com --image-process 'image/resize,w_100,h_200'

test_cases.name: Generate signed URL with HEAD method
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_signed_url.py --bucket-name test-bucket --object-key test.txt --method HEAD --expires 3600 --server obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com

test_cases.name: Generate signed URL with custom query params
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_signed_url.py --bucket-name test-bucket --object-key test.txt --method GET --expires 3600 --server obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com --query-params '{"versionId":"G001"}'

test_cases.name: Generate signed URL with image compress
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_signed_url.py --bucket-name test-bucket --object-key photo.jpg --method GET --expires 3600 --server obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com --image-process 'image/quality,q_85'

test_cases.name: Generate signed URL with multi-operation composite
test_cases.command: python3 scripts/generate_signed_url.py --bucket-name test-bucket --object-key photo.jpg --method GET --expires 3600 --server obs.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com --image-process 'image/resize,w_200,h_200|image/quality,q_85|image/format,png'
test_cases.expected: signedUrl with composite x-image-process in output
